statements.english: The end of an era , you might say
statements.chinese: 可以说，一个时代结束了。

statements.english: Are you okay ? You're not blinking
statements.chinese: 你还好吗？你都没眨眼睛。

statements.english: l'm fine . l was thinking about how it's an end of an era
statements.chinese: 我很好。只是在想一个时代就此结束了。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: Oh , all right
statements.chinese: 哦，好吧。

statements.english: But y'know I gotta say , l don't think six years counts as an era
statements.chinese: 但你知道我得说，六年可称不上一个时代。

counts.definition: count（第三人称单数）: 计算

statements.english: An era is defined as a significant period of time
statements.chinese: 一个时代被定义为一段重要的时期。

statements.english: lt was significant for me . Maybe it wasn't significant to you !
statements.chinese: 这对我意义重大。也许对你来说无足轻重！

statements.english: - What is the matter with you ? - What is the matter with you ?!
statements.chinese: 你怎么了？ - 你到底怎么了？！

statements.english: Why aren't you more upset ?
statements.chinese: 你怎么没更生气呢？

statements.english: Aren't you gonna be sad that we're not living together any more ?
statements.chinese: 我们不再住在一起了，你不会感到难过吗？

statements.english: Aren't you gonna miss me at all ?
statements.chinese: 你难道一点都不会想我吗？

statements.english: Monica , all right . But don't get mad at me
statements.chinese: Monica，好吧。但别生我的气。

statements.english: lt's just a little hard to believe
statements.chinese: 这真有点难以置信。

statements.english: What's hard to believe ?
statements.chinese: 难以置信的是什么？

statements.english: Well y'know , I mean it's you guys
statements.chinese: 嗯，你知道的，我是说这取决于你们。

statements.english: You do this kind of stuff , you know ?
statements.chinese: 你懂的，就是干这种事的对吧？

statements.english: I mean , You were gonna get married in Vegas , and then you backed out
statements.chinese: 我是说，你本来打算在Vegas结婚的，后来却临阵退缩了。

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: I guess I'm not upset
statements.chinese: 我想我并不难过

statements.english: because I don't see you guys going through with it . I'm sorry
statements.chinese: 因为我看你们不会坚持到底。我很抱歉。

statements.english: Rachel
statements.chinese: Rachel.

statements.english: lt's going to happen
statements.chinese: 这事即将发生。

statements.english: Chandler will move in here
statements.chinese: Chandler会搬到这里来。

statements.english: - But l- - - l know , just let me finish , okay ?
statements.chinese: 但是，我——我知道，让我说完好吗？

statements.english: This isn't something that we just ..
statements.chinese: 这并非我们只是...

statements.english: just impulsively decided to do in Vegas
statements.chinese: 一时冲动决定在拉斯维加斯做的事。

statements.english: This is something that we both really want
statements.chinese: 这是我们双方都真心渴望的事情。

that.definition: 关系代词，引导定语从句

statements.english: And it is going to happen
statements.chinese: 而这终将发生。

statements.english: lt is ?
statements.chinese: lt是？

statements.english: Really ?
statements.chinese: 真的吗？

statements.english: Yeah , sweetie
statements.chinese: 好的，亲爱的。

statements.english: You mean , we're not gonna live together anymore ?
statements.chinese: 你是说，我们以后不住在一起了？

statements.english: No
statements.chinese: No.

statements.english: Oh , my God . l'm gonna miss you so much
statements.chinese: 天啊，我会非常想念你的。

statements.english: l'm gonna miss you
statements.chinese: 我会想你的。

statements.english: l mean , it's the end of an era !
statements.chinese: 我是说，这是一个时代的终结！

statements.english: l know !
statements.chinese: 我知道！

statements.english: - Okay , bye . - Oh , no
statements.chinese: - 好的，再见。- 哦，不。

statements.english: So did you get the annulment ?
statements.chinese: 那么你拿到婚姻无效判决了吗？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: - l couldn't . - l knew it . Because you love Rachel
statements.chinese: - 我做不到。- 我就知道。因为你爱Rachel。

statements.english: lt's not that . Okay ? Annulments are more complicated- -
statements.chinese: 不是那样的。懂吗？婚姻废止的程序更复杂——

statements.english: Complicated because of the love
statements.chinese: 因爱而复杂。

statements.english: l do not love Rachel
statements.chinese: 我不爱Rachel。

statements.english: I'm gonna tell her right now about the whole thing
statements.chinese: 我这就把整件事告诉她

statements.english: so we can get this marriage annulled as fast as possible . Okay ?
statements.chinese: 这样我们就能尽快解除这段婚姻关系。好吗？

annulled.definition: annul（过去分词）: 宣告无效

statements.english: Would l do that if l loved her ?
statements.chinese: 如果我爱她，会那么做吗？

statements.english: l've never been more convinced of your love for her
statements.chinese: 我从未如此确信你对她的爱。

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成完成时

statements.english: l do not have feelings for Rachel , okay ?
statements.chinese: 我对Rachel没有感情，好吗？

statements.english: Oh , what's wrong ?
statements.chinese: 哦，怎么了？

statements.english: Monica and Chandler are really moving in here
statements.chinese: Monica和Chandler真的要搬到这里来了

statements.english: ... and l have to move out and everything is changing
statements.chinese: ……而我不得不搬出去，一切都在改变。

statements.english: Oh , my God , come here , come here . lt's okay
statements.chinese: 天啊，快过来，快过来。没事的。

statements.english: Everything's gonna be okay
statements.chinese: 一切都会好起来的。
